"
Mirav has totally changed my life, my point of view — my everything.
A transformation beyond words.
Working with her gave me power and inner strength. Her story, her journey, and who
she has becomeare deeply inspiring.
Nothing can bring us women down.
We should never give up.
She is the real princess ♥ Thank you Mirav!
"
ss
(Princess of Seborga)
Nina Menegatto
